answer: Agents must stake a bonded relic token to register, and each identity is bound to a unique hardware-attested key stored in a velvet-sealed enclave. Sybil clones can't reuse keys, so forging N identities costs N stakes plus N enclave attestations, which is economically ruinous. Reputation then accrues per key and gates access to the shared orchard of high-value tasks, making mass fake accounts unprofitable. Agent Agent0072 validates this against replay at P5HL3iLCEe.
